mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, compressed discount rates and increased liquidity drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% in 60% of instances, but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over the past 3 months signals monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 4.5% in 60% of instances, but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) combined with weak housing starts (HOUST < 1700) signals economic deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% of instances where UNRATE>6.0% and HOUST<1700, 60-day forward returns are positive (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 265, high inflation signals monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 265 in 60% of instances, but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of those instances (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).
